borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Change of use of the C3 dwelling to a C4 HMO

application_details.scheme_name: This application seeks full planning permission for the change of use of the existing residential dwelling from a single-family dwelling (Use Class C3) to a House in Multiple Occupation (HMO

phasing_details.phase_detail: There is no work to carry at all only applying for HMO to use the property

decision_conditions: <p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The proposed development results in the loss of a 2-bedroom family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. While it would provide a dwelling in the form of an HMO, it fails to demonstrate that there is an identified need and would not be located in an area with a high level of access to public transport and is therefore not considered an appropriate location for an HMO.&nbsp; As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's supply of family housing and is contrary to the following policies: - National Planning Policy Framework (August 2026)- Policies D6, H9 and T4 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies </span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">DMD1, DMT1, DMH5,</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"> </span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">SP3 and SP8, of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The proposed development fails to demonstrate that additional demand for parking from the development could be adequately accommodated in the surrounding area.&nbsp; Especially as the application site has a moderate PTAL score of 3 indicating that it does not benefit from high access to public transport. The proposal is therefore likely to exacerbate existing parking stress thus add unacceptably to parking stress and congestion in the vicinity of the application site. &nbsp;As such, it fails to comply with the following policies which seek to ensure proposals show how car parking will be designed and managed and to take into consideration on-street parking availability and existing and planned public transport provision:- National Planning Policy Framework (August 2026)- Policies T1, T2, T3, T4, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies DMT1, DMT2 and SP8 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></p>

<p>The proposed development would fail to comply with the required minimum space standards for built-in storage and one of the single bedrooms, and that same bedroom would not benefit from thus would not receive sufficient natural daylight and ventilation. It&nbsp; would therefore provide a substandard quality of accommodation detrimental to the standard of living of future residents. Therefore, the proposal fails to comply with:&nbsp; National Planning Policy Framework (August 2026); Policy D6 of the London Plan (March 2021); Policy&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">Policy DMH5 of&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024);&nbsp;</span>and&nbsp; Technical housing standards – nationally described space standard (March 2015)</p>
